headings.usage: H1-H4, blockquotes, major chapter titles, hero text.

body.usage: Long-form editorial paragraphs. Selected for high legibility at smaller sizes.

mono.usage: Numbered manifesto chapters, dates, navigation dots, EN/RU toggle, labels.

textures: subtle film grain overlay across the entire page (pointer-events-none)
vignette edge darkening for cinematic feel
visual_enhancers.hero: Subtle parallax/3D hero moment. Kinetic line-by-line reveal for manifesto title.
visual_enhancers.artwork: Spotlight/clipped-frame treatment. Do not use full-screen bleed for all art; instead use sharp geometric frames (aspect-ratio 3/4 or 16/9) with a 1px gold/ember border to look like an exhibition. Add slow ken-burns scale effect inside the frame.

components.flame_indicator: Persistent flame SVG fixed in corner or center-top. Its visual state (color, scale, flicker speed) must change per era/chapter (e.g. vibrant for Samanids, dying embers for Mongol invasion).
components.dot_navigation: Vertical fixed right dot navigation mapping to the 10 chapters. Use JetBrains Mono for chapter numbers.
components.marquee: Slow editorial marquee at the bottom or between major acts (e.g. 'A HISTORY IN FIRE'). Low contrast, serif font.
components.language_toggle: EN/RU text button fixed in top right, styled with JetBrains Mono.
components.audio_control: Floating mute/unmute button using Lucide icons, pulsing softly when audio is active.

layouts.scrollytelling: Sticky Canvas pattern. Content container flows normally while the artwork/media container uses `position: sticky; top: 15vh; align-self: start;`. Avoid `overflow: hidden` on ancestors.
layouts.spacing: Massive generous spacing. Use `py-32`, `py-48`, or `min-h-screen` for sections to give narrative breathing room.

motion.scroll_reveals: Framer Motion `whileInView`. Elements should fade up (`y: 30`, `opacity: 0` to `y: 0`, `opacity: 1`) with a slow, heavy easing.
motion.hero: Kinetic text reveal (staggered line by line using framer motion variants).
motion.smooth_scroll: Lenis library must be used for momentum scrolling to give weight to the narrative.

accessibility.audio: Audio MUST NOT autoplay without explicit user interaction (e.g., an 'Enter Experience' button or a visible play-through toggle). Mute button is required.
accessibility.contrast: Text over images must have a scrim or background overlay to maintain APCA readability.

media.audio_engine: Per-chapter ambient audio crossfade engine. Map audio tracks to active chapters via IntersectionObserver. Crossfade volumes smoothly using React state/refs on scroll.

chapter_1.description: Zoroastrian Sogdiana / Fire Temples. Wooden structure engulfed in flames.

chapter_4.description: Alexander's phalanx / Mongol siege. Steel and chainmail armor.

chapter_7.description: Traditional village life / Russian border-drawing. Mountain village architecture.

chapter_10.description: Andarak today. Ancient stone pathway at twilight.

instructions_to_main_agent: Import Google Fonts directly into the CSS file.
Use standard HTML5 `<audio>` tags with a robust React custom hook for crossfading logic based on the active chapter index.
Implement the scrollytelling sections using CSS `position: sticky` on the artwork side, and normally scrolling text on the content side.
Use Framer Motion for line-by-line kinetic hero text and page-level scroll reveals.
Install and configure `@studio-freight/lenis` or `lenis` for smooth, heavy momentum scrolling.
Add `lucide-react` for icons like mute/unmute and language toggle.
The persistent flame SVG should use Framer Motion variants to transition its state smoothly based on the active chapter (e.g., changes in opacity, scale, and color).
Never use generic placeholder text; structure the narrative with the 10 chapters.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling. Embrace asymmetry.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) sparingly for navigation/audio controls only. Avoid solid transparency under text.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
